title: GenAI & Agentic AI Security Incidents
description: A continuously-maintained, single-source-of-truth dataset of publicly disclosed GenAI and agentic-AI security incidents, vulnerabilities, and red-team findings. Every entry is mapped to OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications (2025), OWASP Agentic Top 10 (ASI), NIST AI Risk Management Framework (AI 100-1), and MITRE ATLAS.
